_comment: Real JdK RS-Ratio / RS-Momentum read off the official Optuma RRG (SPDR S&P US Sectors ETF, weekly, benchmark SPY). Ships in the repo so a plain git-pull deploy makes the sector panel agree with the chart -- no API key, no manual POST. A point stored in the rrg_points table with a NEWER as_of wins over this seed, so posting a fresh reading via POST /api/rrg always takes precedence. When this date goes stale, update it here and it travels to every machine.
